task_title: AUG-148: refuse a symlink that resolves outside the corpus root, on the discovery path as well as the include path, without leaking host-file content
task_criteria: PROOF: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k out_of_root_symlink prints 1 passed. FAILIF: any failure, error, or a pass count other than 1.
PROOF: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k in_root_symlink prints 1 passed. FAILIF: any failure, error, or a pass count other than 1, which would mean the fix over-blocks ordinary symlinks.
PROOF: grep -c symlink-outside-root ./auger.py prints at least 2. FAILIF: zero or one occurrence, meaning the typed refusal code is missing from the loader and the diagnostic.
PROOF: grep -c SENTINEL-CONTENT-DO-NOT-LEAK tests/test_xml_specs.py prints 1. FAILIF: zero, meaning the no-leak assertion vanished from the out-of-root fixture test.
PROOF: grep -c tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/gate.sh prints at least 2. FAILIF: the gate pytest arm no longer names the test file, so the enforced fix would be invisible to the gate.

items.criterion: PROOF: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k out_of_root_symlink prints 1 passed. FAILIF: any failure, error, or a pass count other than 1.
items.detail: `python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k out_of_root_symlink` -> exit_code 0, output ".  [100%]\n1 passed, 57 deselected in 0.05s". Test defined at tests/test_xml_specs.py:1320.

items.criterion: PROOF: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k in_root_symlink prints 1 passed. FAILIF: any failure, error, or a pass count other than 1, which would mean the fix over-blocks ordinary symlinks.
items.detail: `python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k in_root_symlink` -> exit_code 0, output ".  [100%]\n1 passed, 57 deselected in 0.14s". Test at tests/test_xml_specs.py:1378 links frag.xml -> fragments/shared.inc (a non-*.xml target, so the link is the only route) and asserts documents == ["frag.xml","real.xml"] and blocks ["SL-FRAG-1","SL-REAL-1"] — no over-blocking.

items.criterion: PROOF: grep -c symlink-outside-root ./auger.py prints at least 2. FAILIF: zero or one occurrence, meaning the typed refusal code is missing from the loader and the diagnostic.
items.detail: `grep -c symlink-outside-root ./auger.py` -> 2. Occurrences at auger.py:7994 (docstring of _spec_discover_documents) and auger.py:8023 (the typed code emitted in the ValueError branch when `resolved.relative_to(root)` fails). Wired into all three loaders: load_spec_corpus auger.py:8743, load_spec_corpus_indexed auger.py:8819, _xml_spec_documents auger.py:13077.

items.criterion: PROOF: grep -c SENTINEL-CONTENT-DO-NOT-LEAK tests/test_xml_specs.py prints 1. FAILIF: zero, meaning the no-leak assertion vanished from the out-of-root fixture test.
items.detail: `grep -c SENTINEL-CONTENT-DO-NOT-LEAK tests/test_xml_specs.py` -> 1. Defined at tests/test_xml_specs.py:1328 and asserted absent from err/out/detail at lines 1352, 1362, 1363, 1372.

items.criterion: PROOF: grep -c tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/gate.sh prints at least 2. FAILIF: the gate pytest arm no longer names the test file, so the enforced fix would be invisible to the gate.
items.detail: `grep -c tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/gate.sh` -> 2. Line 157 (comment naming the suite) and line 206 (the live pytest arm: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_auger.py ... tests/test_xml_specs.py ...`). .gitreins/config.yaml:15 sets `test_command: bash tests/gate.sh`, so the arm is the enforced path.

items.criterion: The new refusal is reachable from the real CLI entrypoint (`auger spec validate` / `check` / `list`), not only from the in-process test helper — i.e. all three corpus loaders route through the single discovery function that emits `symlink-outside-root`.
items.detail: All three loaders call _spec_discover_documents: auger.py:8743 (load_spec_corpus), auger.py:8819 (load_spec_corpus_indexed), auger.py:13077 (_xml_spec_documents); those are reached from the verbs at auger.py:9446/9478/9896/10205/11053/11646/11816/12230 and auger.py:13324/13599. Live CLI probe: `auger spec validate corpus` with linked.xml -> outside/secret.xml printed "spec error (symlink-outside-root): linked.xml: the symlink resolves to /tmp/leakprobe/outside/secret.xml, outside the corpus root /tmp/leakprobe/corpus (only local documents inside the root are read)", EXIT=2.

items.criterion: The refusal is emitted before any bytes of the out-of-root target are read, so no host-file content can reach stdout/stderr or the SpecError detail (the no-leak property holds structurally, not just by the sentinel assertion).
items.detail: In _spec_discover_documents (auger.py:8000-8032) the resolve/relative_to check and the refusal append precede `paths.append(path)`; read_bytes only runs later in _spec_read_document (auger.py:7942) for paths that passed. The detail interpolates only `rel`, `resolved` and `root` (auger.py:8025-8027). Live CLI probe printed only those paths — no sentinel.

items.criterion: The include path's out-of-root refusal still works after the change (the task requires the rule on the discovery path "as well as the include path" — the fix must not have replaced or broken the existing include refusal).
items.detail: Live probe with `<include src="/tmp/leakprobe/outside/secret.xml"/>` -> "spec error (remote-reference-rejected): real.xml: include src '/tmp/leakprobe/outside/secret.xml' (only repository-relative local files are allowed)", EXIT=2. The include refusal is intact alongside the new discovery refusal.

items.criterion: The change does not regress the rest of the XML spec suite (full file green, not just the two new tests).
items.detail: `python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q` -> exit_code 0, "58 passed in 1.05s". Also `-k symlink` -> "2 passed, 56 deselected".
